title: Simply Chunk Wand
description: Keeps chunks loaded using pure vanilla commands and questionable wizardry.
body:
Simply Chunk Wand is a chunk loading solution for people who just want things to keep working without any heavy mod to chunk it.

No machines.
No complicated GUIs.

Just a wand, a wave, and a chunk that suddenly realizes it’s never allowed to unload again.

Built entirely using vanilla Minecraft commands, this mod keeps things simple, reliable, and surprisingly configurable.

Perfect for servers, singleplayer worlds, and anyone who thinks chunk loaders should be easy, and effective.

Wave wand.
Chunk stay loaded.
Problem solved.

P/S: Can't remove all chunks that loaded so must remove one-by-one
